event: Several initial catalogue/ledger/combined source outputs exceeded tool output limits. Focused relevant proof passages were re-read; no full semantic ledger reading is claimed.
An rg --files call on the ignored I14 ZK directory omitted --no-ignore and produced no paths. Repeated with --no-ignore; no absence inference retained.
All original I114 failure records remain sealed in that package, including stale Fang v1, failed requests and title-pass correction. No inherited failure was removed.
Original direct unequal-temperature linear-qEPI bridge has a positive baseline at Delta=0. It remains invalid.
Finite-cutoff/floor stationarity budget pays a positivity radius m/2 too small for the uniform cutoff error. No vanishing gradient bound follows.

Exact-entropy rare tails disprove vanishing weighted-Q and thermal-relative-entropy transfer; entropy-preserving two-level rotations additionally disprove ordinary HS balance transfer and exclude alpha>1/2.
Cuesta v1 preceding Eq. (41), repeated preceding Eq. (67), displays |z1-z2|^2 <= (|z1|^2+|z2|^2)/2, false for z1=1,z2=-1. Not silently repaired or imported; this is not a disproof of its theorem.
